independent.summary: The church-config extract still uses ONE embedding query for all six fields, and the diff appends 'service times worship schedule Sunday' to it. retrieveContext hard-filters at 0.75, so diluting the shared query vector can push mission/statement-of-faith chunks below the threshold and shrink the context the extract sees — a possible regression in the five pre-existing proposals. A second, schedule-specific retrieval merged into the context would avoid the tradeoff.

triageGrades.reason: No auth/permission logic changes — serviceTimes is added inside the already superadmin-gated churchConfig rule and the extract route's isSuperAdmin check is untouched.
No credential or secret handling; the only key reference is a dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY placeholder in a unit test.
Nothing in billing, Stripe, quota or pricing paths is touched.
The Entity schema addition is optional and additive, and no deletes, migrations or overwrites of existing data occur.

The change does alter external API calls — it rewrites the Anthropic Haiku extract prompt, changes the Voyage embedding query in retrieveContext, and adds text to the system prompt and context message sent to the Claude messages API.
No migration or deploy gating; the new SERVICE_TIMES_LOG_LEVEL env var is documented with a working default, so a release needs no action.

summary: A no-findings verdict is largely defensible here — the change is small, gated, and unusually well covered by both backend and dashboard unit tests — but the local model produced no evidence of having examined anything and mis-triaged externalApi despite the diff plainly rewriting Anthropic prompt payloads and the embedding query.
